selection: Deterministic central 40 x 30 ft subregions of the already documented A/B bounding boxes; no new point, image, label, prediction or score inspection used. Whole parent tiles are protected context.
prior_exposure: A/B appeared in historical whole-scene figures before this protocol. This is a prospective tuning holdout, not a claim of historically unseen imagery.
bounds_convention: xmin <= x < xmax and ymin <= y < ymax; all heights
rules: Before Phase 5 do not open, hash, visualize, infer, score, or use cached content from A/B; only this published box metadata may be read.
Development preprocessing/inference must use tile C only and reject overlap with protected boxes. No survey-wide caches may be used.
Freeze final manifest and commit before Phase 5. The gate records a single irreversible consumption event.
If independent reference labels are absent, create prediction-hidden annotation exports and stop evaluation; no estimated accuracy.
Never author or modify reference labels.
